_comment: 이 파일을 kit.config.json 으로 복사해 자기 프로젝트 값으로 바꾼다 (scripts/new_project.py 가 대신 해 준다). 필드가 없으면 scripts/kitconfig.py 의 DEFAULTS(알리랑 값)가 그대로 쓰인다.

style.tail: Bright colorful low-poly 3D clay-like models with soft rounded edges, warm pastel palette, on a clean pale cream studio background with a faint soft ground shadow. Soft warm studio lighting from upper left, no harsh shadows. Clean playful explainer animation look, not photorealistic, not cinematic, not dark. No numbers, no lettering, no text, no captions, no watermark, no UI, no logo.

characters.CH: a round clay child with a simple round face, two small dark eyes and rosy cheeks, wearing a blue shirt
characters.MOM: a taller clay parent figure wearing a mint green cardigan, a friendly clay mother with a simple round human face, short black bob hair, two small dark eyes and rosy cheeks
characters.FR: a smiling clay classmate in a coral shirt
characters.GRAND: a kind clay grandfather figure with short white hair and a soft grey vest
characters.C2: a round clay child with a simple round face, two small dark eyes and rosy cheeks, wearing a blue shirt, a small boy with light peach skin and a full head of short brown hair,
characters.F2: a smiling clay classmate in a coral shirt with short black hair
characters.MP: a taller clay parent figure wearing a mint green cardigan, a friendly clay mother with a simple round human face, short black bob hair, two small dark eyes and rosy cheeks with light peach skin
characters.LT: placed at the left third of the frame, plain soft cream wall filling the whole right half.
characters.DAD: a taller clay parent figure wearing a sky blue cardigan, a friendly clay father with a simple round human face, short black hair, two small round eyes and rosy cheeks
characters.DP: a taller clay parent figure wearing a sky blue cardigan, a friendly clay father with a simple round human face, short black hair, two small round eyes and rosy cheeks with light peach skin
